# Grounded Tierra

Grounded Tierra pairs light and dark palettes its recorded description compares to morning cream and walnut evenings, unified by subtle coral accents. It states writer-first typography, generous margins and contrast at the WCAG AAA level for long writing sessions; that contrast claim is the description own and was not measured here.
